title: Magnetostatics
description: A steady current makes a magnetic field that circles the wire and weakens with distance from it. The first study of electromagnetism. Unlocks the Gauss Meter.

puzzle.goal: A long straight wire carries a steady current I. Its magnetic field circles the wire; integrate the field around a circle of radius r and the total is fixed by the current through it. Write the field strength B at distance r.
puzzle.name: Ampère's circuital law for a straight wire
puzzle.ask: Find B in microtesla 5 cm from a wire carrying @{I} A.
puzzle.method: Around any closed loop the field adds up to μ₀ times the current threading it; by symmetry B is the same all round the circle of length 2πr.
